lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
Listen to music! I listen to music in the car.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

native.tip: Kata “mendengarkan” sudah lengkap, tapi bahasa Inggris butuh to: listen to music.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I listen music every day.” 😅 Setelah listen, tambahkan to: “I listen to music every day.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “listen to music”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I listen to music every day.” Lalu sebut lagu favoritmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: The word “mendengarkan” is complete, but English needs to: listen to music.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I listen music every day.” 😅 After listen, add to: “I listen to music every day.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
